scene_summary: A cellophane-sealed retail card rests on burlap, printed with glossy airbrushed graffiti bubble forms in rainbow gradients over a lime-green ground. A brushed-steel drive slab with a rounded end and a circular aperture glowing yellow lies across the lower bubble masses, under the crinkled plastic.

detected_objects.label: Brushed-steel drive slab with glowing yellow ring aperture over bubble forms
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A horizontal rectangular metal bar with fine brushed grain, a squared left end, and a rounded right end with a circular hole showing bright yellow. It overlaps the cyan and magenta-violet bubble masses, and its shadowed lower and left edges separate it from the card beneath the cellophane.
